name: Sanbra
tagline: Book rides across Ghana with upfront fares and mobile money payments
description: Sanbra connects riders with drivers, shows fares before booking and supports live trip tracking and Mobile Money payments.

name: SyntraStore
tagline: Manage sales, stock and reports for shops and restaurants
description: SyntraStore combines point of sale, inventory and sales reporting for Ghanaian retailers and restaurants, with desktop and web tools.

name: Shaxi
tagline: Book rides and browse local listings in one Ghanaian app
description: Shaxi brings ride booking together with a Ghanaian marketplace, property listings, jobs and mobile money payments.

name: Tendo
tagline: Resell products online without holding stock
description: Tendo lets resellers browse wholesale products, set a profit margin and share items with customers while Tendo handles fulfilment.

name: Built
tagline: Manage invoices, accounting and payroll for your business
description: Built gives small businesses tools for invoicing, expenses, accounting, inventory, payroll and financial reports.

name: Bisa App
tagline: Speak with health professionals from your phone
description: Bisa lets people in Ghana ask doctors and other health professionals about their health without first travelling to a hospital.

name: eCampus
tagline: Learn with lessons, practice tests and feedback
description: eCampus offers digital learning and practice tools for students, teachers, workers and lifelong learners.

name: CediWise
tagline: Check your pay and manage budgets, debts and business records
description: CediWise combines a Ghana PAYE and SSNIT calculator with budgeting, debt tracking, an SME ledger and money lessons.

name: SKUUNI
tagline: Manage school records, attendance, reports and fees online
description: SKUUNI is a web-based school management platform for student records, staff, attendance, report cards, fee collection and accounting.

name: DropACookie
tagline: Give Ghanaian creators direct support for what they share
description: DropACookie gives creators a way to share posts and receive support directly from their fans.

name: Asori
tagline: Bring church members, services, attendance and care into one app
description: Asori helps churches coordinate members, services, attendance, follow-up, communication and reporting across mobile and web.
